caption: The drawing depicts a stylized, angular object resembling a decorated box or headrest with geometric and organic motifs. The main colors used are red, yellow, blue, black, and shades of cream. The front panel features symmetrical designs, with two large red shapes at the center resembling stylized plant forms or abstract figures, flanked by blue vertical elements with black accents suggesting stems or feathers. At the top, there is a prominent red, fan-shaped motif with yellow cutout sections, surrounded by two small pomegranate-like shapes at either upper corner. The lower part of the object displays a rectangular section with a red, textured interior bordered in blue and black. The sides contain layered triangular and curved patterns in red, blue, green, and yellow, outlined heavily in black. The overall structure has sharp angles and rounded protrusions on the left, with a cream background and minimal shading, and the number "18" appears in the upper left corner.
title: Plate 18: Reading Stand, Llano: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
